name: bubble

frames.best_why: Shows the full thread plus the party reaction badge that appears only after the long message is clicked.

tagline: Chat thread whose long message pops a party reaction when clicked.
summary: A small chat window with a contact header and message bubbles in several tones and alignments. Clicking the long reply adds a party-popper reaction badge with a count.
appearance: A dark rounded card starts with a tiny avatar and contact header, then a stack of message bubbles: grey on the left, white on the right, a pale green tint and a red error bubble. Bubbles are rounded rectangles of varied widths.
behaviour: The long right-hand message is a button; clicking it toggles a small party-popper badge with a count that overlaps its lower edge. Bubble colour and side follow the chosen variant and alignment.
demo_content: Contact Maya Patel shown as Active now, with lines about a shipped onboarding flow and a dashboard link.
use_when: A page needs to preview or mock a conversation with clear sender sides and message tones.
avoid_when: It is a presentational shell: sending, typing and live updates must be wired up yourself.
customise: Message text is passed as children; variant, alignment and reaction side/alignment are props, while colours come from theme tokens.
weight_why: Plain DOM bubbles with a conditional badge; nothing animates on its own.

a11y.note: The clickable bubble has a focus ring, but the reaction badge and emoji carry no accessible label or live announcement.

polish_why: Clean chat card with convincing variants and a neat reaction badge.
